title: Normalized realization section scalar comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite normed extensions $E,F/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a continuous $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding $i:E\to F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], any scheme $W$, and normalized realization charts $A_E,A_F$ [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization-records]. Let $r$ be a morphism of the underlying condensed abelian coefficient sheaves which acts on each profinite test section by pointwise application of $i$. Let $d$ be a morphism of their reconstructed section rings whose section functions equal those of the scheme pullback of $r$ [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding]. For each test object $U$, reconstructed section $b$ and point $x\in U$, the $A_F$ chart value of $d(b)$ is $i$ applied to the $A_E$ chart value of $b$.

source.place: Definition 6.8.1 and Lemma 6.8.2(1), with the profinite-test identification in Lemma 4.2.12. Agent-written normalized coefficient-chart argument for setup proof Step 12.

proof.text: Construct pointwise postcomposition by i as a morphism between the original sheaves of continuous E- and F-valued functions. Continuity gives a map of continuous functions and additivity gives an abelian-sheaf map.

Apply the point-pullback adjunction Hom bijection to the proposed coefficient-object square. Its naturality puts r before the F-chart adjunct on one side and postcomposition after the E-chart adjunct on the other. The coefficient normalizations identify these on profinite tests: both apply i after composition with the same test projection. Extensionality and injectivity of the adjunction bijection prove the square.
Apply the square to a section and evaluate at x. The prescribed section functions of d and the two section chart normalizations give the asserted formula. No nonempty or noetherian hypothesis enters.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedRealizationSectionScalar
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E F : Type u) [NormedField E] [NormedField F]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] F]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] F]
    (i : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F) (hi : Continuous i) (W : Scheme.{u})
    (AE : CondensedERealization.At l E W) (AF : CondensedERealization.At l F W)
    (r : Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E ⟶ Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj F)
    (hr : ∀ (S : Profinite.{u}) (f : C(S, E)) (x : S),
      ((r.hom.app (op S)) (ULift.up f)).down x = i (f x))
    (d : CondensedERealization.SectionRing E W ⟶ CondensedERealization.SectionRing F W)
    (hd : ∀ (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (b : (CondensedERealization.SectionRing E W).obj.obj U),
      HEq (d.hom.app U b) ((coefficientMap r W).hom.app U b))
    (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (b : (CondensedERealization.SectionRing E W).obj.obj U)
    (x : U.unop.left) :
    rationalCoefficientValue l F W U (AF.sectionIso.hom.hom.app U (d.hom.app U b)) x =
      i (rationalCoefficientValue l E W U (AE.sectionIso.hom.hom.app U b) x)
